messages:
marta: Quick catch on PR #5123 1 rerank docs: the example response reverses the score order and the OpenAPI example omits the `rerank_scores` array we actually return. Also the curl snippet in the page shows a lowercase `authorization` header which confuses some users. The Go SDK snippet shows topK as an integer in the example but the SDK accepts float in the param object so folks get a type mismatch.
ishan: Headline fixes: 1) canonicalize header examples to `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (while HTTP header names are case-insensitive, our examples should be consistent), 2) make the response example include `rerank_scores: [0.91, 0.47, 0.12]` aligned to the candidates array order.
prashant: I'll update openapi/generated.yml to replace the broken example response and add `rerank_scores` + a short description. I'll also add a tiny test that validates example arrays length equals candidates length.
olivia: I'll take the language snippets (curl, js, python, go). For the Go example I'll change the sample to show top_k: 3 as an explicit int in the JSON body and document that SDK helper coerces numeric values. I'll also normalize header casing in all the curl examples.
ryan: I'll add a docs-lint rule in the CI that checks for `rerank_scores` presence when endpoint is /v1/rerank and warns if missing. Also adding a quick unit that parses the OpenAPI examples and asserts score array length matches candidates.
emily: Can we also add a short migration note on the page saying: "If you relied on the implicit ordering of candidate scores, please use the explicit rerank_scores array introduced in v1.2"? I'll draft a one-liner for the changelog.
marta: Example bad curl from PR:

```bash
# incorrect (from PR)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "find best", "candidates": ["a","b","c"]}'
```

Corrected canonical curl we should show:

```bash
# canonical (docs)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "query": "find best",
    "candidates": ["a", "b", "c"],
    "top_k": 3
  }'
```

marta: Example corrected response shape that we'll put in OpenAPI/example section:

```json
{
  "query": "find best",
  "candidates": ["a", "b", "c"],
  "rerank_scores": [0.91, 0.47, 0.12],
  "top_indices": [0, 1, 2]
}
```

ishan: Note: top_indices is optional but handy for clients that want indices instead of full objects. Keep it in example but mark optional in description.
prashant: I'll push a tiny generated.yml update + the test. If CI passes I'll merge and ping this thread.
olivia: Pushed snippet updates to branch fix-rerank-examples and updated the deploy preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/5123  replaced header casing, fixed Go snippet example, and updated examples in page.
doc-bot: CI: docs-lint passed, example-schema-check failed on preview build (caught missing rerank_scores in one example). Preview URL: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/5123
ryan: Good catch CI. I merged the test-fix branch into the docs branch and re-ran. New preview shows the updated response example across docs. Lint/test green.
emily: Changelog blurb drafted: "Clarify /v1/rerank response now includes explicit rerank_scores array and examples standardize Authorization header casing. Update Go SDK snippet to show top_k usage." I'll add it under docs changes.
marta: Thanks team. Once merged I'll close the PR and add an internal note for support to reroute any tickets caused by the previous example.
